description: This file defines the ModelDataFileReader class which is responsible for reading and parsing XML configuration files that define data file models in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading file definitions, creating model record and field objects, and managing cache.

classes.name: ModelDataFileReader
classes.description: Final class responsible for reading and parsing data file model definitions from XML files, managing a cache of readers, and providing access to data file models.

methods.name: getModelDataFileReader
methods.description: Factory method for obtaining a cached ModelDataFileReader instance for a given URL.

methods.name: createModelDataFile
methods.description: Constructs a ModelDataFile object from its corresponding XML element.

methods.name: createModelDataFiles
methods.description: Loads and parses the XML document to create a map of data file definitions.

methods.name: createModelField
methods.description: Creates a ModelField object from its XML element.

methods.name: createModelRecord
methods.description: Creates a ModelRecord object from its XML element.

methods.name: getDataFileNames
methods.description: Returns a collection of data file names defined in the configuration.

methods.name: getDataFileNamesIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over data file names.

methods.name: getModelDataFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ModelDataFile by name.

methods.name: getModelDataFiles
methods.description: Returns the map of all ModelDataFile objects.
